en: “Haaa—Morning...”
“It's not even seven yet. Did you stay up late again last night?”
“Yeah, I only slept for two hours.”
“...*yawn*... I don't wanna go out... so tired...”
“Can't believe you manage to wake up and work on time every day.”
“Waking up in the morning is like torture.”
“Is that... why you were sent to be a nun?”
“Hmm... you really wanna know?”
“N-No... just a bit curious.”
“It's nothing big.”
“I just did something Dad didn't like.”
“Is it the same for all three of you?”
“Just me and Ayano, Kasumi volunteered to join us.”
“I see.”
“Want to know more?”
“...Me too.”
“You are my employers, so I'd obviously love to know more about you.”
“Hey... You don't have to see me as your employer after... that?”
“For Kasumi, you'd have to ask her, I don't really want to talk about it.”
“For me...”
“Never mind, I don't wanna talk about it.”
When talking about herself, Shizuku always seems to unconsciously look away.
Feels like... she doesn't want to show me how shy she is?
Ayano's just too free-spirited, Dad couldn't stand it, so he sent her here to cool down.
“You two don't get along?”
“We're just on different wavelengths.”
“Her personality is totally different from mine.”
“But it must be a hoot when you're both together? I can imagine what it's like hanging out with you two.”
“It's... noisy.”
“I see...”
“What about breakfast?”
“Bacon and eggs with some salad.”
“Mkay..”
“And toast with jam.”
“Oh, nice~”
“If you have any preferences, just let me know.”
“I want chocolate.”
“Chocolate?”
“Anything's fine as long as there's chocolate.”
“Ha, okay.”
“Haaaa... So tired...”
“Better catch up on sleep after breakfast, you only need to go to the church in the afternoon, right?”
“Yeah... make sure to wake me up.”
“Just wait a bit then, breakfast's almost ready.”
